preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 parent integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < i for i, p in enumerate(parents, start=2))
preconditions.description: For each node i from 2 to n, its parent p_i satisfies 1 <= p_i < i, ensuring a valid rooted tree structure rooted at 1.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count modulo 998244353.

The output equals the number of valid partitions of the leaf set modulo 998244353, where a partition is valid if the smallest connected subgraphs containing each subset of the partition are pairwise disjoint.
